name: ideation
description: One /ideation entry point, at the right depth: just do it, a short plan, an evidence-gated interview stress-tested by four adversarial plan critics, or a map for foggy multi-session work, opening with a no-files 'should we?' conversation when the question is whether to build at all. Every depth writes a living, versioned plan (plan.json) you answer on a page or in the terminal. Approval is always a terminal confirmation, and it hands the run contract to a deterministic workflow engine that builds, reviews and commits each unit. Watched runs teach the next interview.
